player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} kwi-**Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Ngenisa isithethi sakho njenge-**[macro  micro]** (nambari zimbini 0-8):
• *macro*  = ipi ibhodi-ncinci udlala kuyo
• *micro* = ipi iskhwele kwi-bhodi-ncinci leyo
Isibonelo `[7 8]` ➜ beka isikhala sakho kwi-bhodi-ncinci 7, iskhwele 8, bese
ugawula udlali wakho ukuba adlale kwi-bhodi-ncinci 8 emva.

Ungu `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ukutshintshela kufuneka kube kwifomu [macro micro] kunye neenombolo 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: I-indices nganye kufuneka ibe phakathi ko-0 no-8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: I-micro_board, row okanye col ingaphandle komgama.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Umdlali kufuneka adlale kwibhodi elandelayo encinci.

game_action.played: Umdlali {player_id} udlale kwi-bhodi-ncinci {macro_idx}, iskhwele {micro_idx} (umzila {row}, ikolomu {col}). Umdlali {opponent_id} kufuneka adlale kwi-{nxt_txt} manje.

outcome.win: Umdlali {player_id} uphumelele i-Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
